title: Showing Confirmation
text: Just confirming our showing appointment for [Property Address] on [Date] at [Time]. Looking forward to seeing you there! Let me know if anything changes on your end.

title: Post-Showing Follow-up
text: Thanks for viewing [Property Address] with me today! What were your initial thoughts? Happy to discuss further or schedule a second look if you're interested.

title: New Listing Alert Match
text: Hi [Client Name], a new property just hit the market that seems like a great match for what you're looking for: [Property Address]. Would you be interested in taking a look this week? Here's the link: [Link - Optional]

title: Open House Reminder
text: Quick reminder about the open house at [Property Address] this [Day], [Date] from [Start Time] to [End Time]. Hope you can make it!

title: Offer Submitted Notification
text: Good news! We've officially submitted your offer for [Property Address]. I'll keep you updated as soon as I hear back from the listing agent.

title: Counter-Offer Received
text: We've received a counter-offer on [Property Address]. I've attached the details for your review. Let's connect soon to discuss our next steps.

title: Offer Accepted!
text: Fantastic news! Your offer for [Property Address] has been accepted! Congratulations! I'll be in touch shortly with the next steps regarding inspection and closing.

title: Offer Not Accepted
text: Unfortunately, the seller decided to go with another offer for [Property Address]. While disappointing, we'll keep searching and find the right one for you. Let's discuss strategy moving forward.

title: Listing Agreement Follow-up
text: Thanks for meeting with me today! Please review the listing agreement we discussed for [Property Address]. Let me know if you have any questions before signing.

title: Photo/Staging Prep Reminder
text: Just a reminder that the photographer is scheduled for [Date] at [Time]. Please ensure the house is photo-ready as per the staging checklist we discussed. Let me know if you need anything!

title: Listing is Live!
text: Exciting news! Your listing for [Property Address] is now live on the MLS and major real estate websites! You can view it here: [Link - Optional]. I'll keep you posted on showing activity.

title: Showing Feedback Request (Agent)
text: Hi [Agent Name], thanks for showing [Property Address] today. Would you mind sharing any feedback your clients had? Appreciate your time!

title: Offer Received Notification
text: We've received an offer on [Property Address]! I've attached the details for your review. Let's schedule a time to discuss it soon.

title: Multiple Offers Received
text: We're in a great position! We've received multiple offers on [Property Address]. I'm preparing a summary for you, and we should connect soon to review them all.

title: Accepted Offer - Next Steps
text: Congratulations! We have an accepted offer on [Property Address]. The next steps involve the buyer's inspection and appraisal. I'll coordinate the details and keep you informed.

title: Closing Day Reminder
text: Just a reminder that your closing for [Property Address] is scheduled for [Date] at [Time] at [Location]. Please remember to bring your photo ID. Almost there!

title: Check-in / Market Update
text: Hi [Client Name], just checking in! Hope you're doing well. The market is [brief market condition - e.g., still moving quickly/seeing some shifts]. Let me know if you have any questions or if your search/selling criteria have changed.

title: Document Request
text: Could you please send over the [Document Name] needed for the [Property Address] transaction when you have a moment? Let me know if you have any trouble finding it. Thanks!

title: Meeting Confirmation
text: Confirming our meeting on [Date] at [Time] at [Location/Platform]. Looking forward to connecting!

title: Thank You / Post-Closing
text: It was such a pleasure helping you [buy/sell] [Property Address]! Congratulations again. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything in the future, or if you know anyone looking for real estate assistance!

title: Showing Request
text: Hi [Agent Name], I'd like to request a showing for your listing at [Property Address] for my clients on [Date] around [Time]. Please let me know if that works. Thanks!

title: Offer Question
text: Regarding the offer submitted for [Property Address], could you clarify [Specific Question]? Thanks!

title: Offer Presentation Info
text: Following up on the offer for [Property Address]. Do you know when the seller(s) plan to review offers?

title: Listing Question
text: Quick question about your listing at [Property Address]: [Specific Question about listing details]? Appreciate the info!
